items.prompt:
The instrument used to measure small lengths to 0.01 cm precision is the:

A) Vernier callipers
B) Metre rule
C) Measuring tape
D) Trundle wheel

Using s = ut + ½at^2, the distance covered from rest with a = 4 m/s^2 in 3 s is:

A) 36 m
B) 12 m
C) 18 m
D) 6 m

Near the Earth's surface the acceleration due to gravity is approximately:

A) 100 m/s^2
B) 10 m/s^2
C) 1 m/s^2
D) 9.8 km/s^2

A body falls freely from rest for 2 s (g = 10 m/s^2). The distance fallen is:

A) 40 m
B) 10 m
C) 5 m
D) 20 m

A uniform metre rule balances at its centre. A 4 N weight at 20 cm from the pivot is balanced by a weight at 40 cm of:

A) 2 N
B) 8 N
C) 4 N
D) 0.5 N

The kinetic energy of a 2 kg body moving at 10 m/s is:

A) 100 J
B) 20 J
C) 200 J
D) 10 J

A 4 kg body moves at 5 m/s. Its kinetic energy is:

A) 100 J
B) 50 J
C) 20 J
D) 10 J

A 4 kg body at 5 m/s sticks to a stationary 1 kg body on impact. The common velocity is:

A) 5 m/s
B) 4 m/s
C) 1 m/s
D) 20 m/s

A 2 kg rifle recoils when a 0.01 kg bullet leaves at 400 m/s. The recoil speed of the rifle is:

A) 4 m/s
B) 0.5 m/s
C) 2 m/s
D) 8 m/s

The minimum speed a body needs to completely escape the Earth's gravitational field is the:

A) Escape velocity
B) Terminal velocity
C) Orbital velocity
D) Critical velocity

A 600 N person stands on a floor with feet covering 0.03 m^2. The pressure is:

A) 18 Pa
B) 0.00005 Pa
C) 600 Pa
D) 20000 Pa

A body displaces 0.002 m^3 of water (ρ = 1000 kg/m^3, g = 10 m/s^2). The upthrust on it is:

A) 2 N
B) 200 N
C) 0.02 N
D) 20 N

The point beyond which a stretched spring does not return to its original length is the:

A) Yield drop
B) Elastic limit
C) Focal point
D) Neutral point

A force of 12 N stretches a spring by 0.04 m. The spring constant is:

A) 0.48 N/m
B) 3 N/m
C) 0.0033 N/m
D) 300 N/m

The heat needed to raise 0.5 kg of a metal (c = 400 J/kg K) by 20 K is:

A) 4000 J
B) 400 J
C) 8000 J
D) 16000 J

Heat capacity equals mass × specific heat capacity. For 3 kg of water (c = 4200 J/kg K) it is:

A) 1400 J/K
B) 12600 J/K
C) 4200 J/K
D) 126000 J/K

A gas of volume 300 cm^3 at 300 K is heated at constant pressure to 600 K. Its new volume is:

A) 150 cm^3
B) 300 cm^3
C) 600 cm^3
D) 900 cm^3

A gas at 200 kPa and 300 K is heated at constant volume to 600 K. Its new pressure is:

A) 100 kPa
B) 200 kPa
C) 900 kPa
D) 400 kPa

The heat to melt 0.5 kg of ice (L = 336000 J/kg) at 0 °C is:

A) 672000 J
B) 336000 J
C) 672 J
D) 168000 J

The heat to boil away 2 kg of water (L = 2260000 J/kg) at 100 °C is:

A) 4520000 J
B) 1130000 J
C) 2260000 J
D) 4520 J

Increasing the external pressure on a liquid will raise its:

A) Melting point only
B) Density to zero
C) Latent heat to zero
D) Boiling point

An echo returns 2 s after a shout, with sound at 340 m/s. The reflecting wall is at a distance of:

A) 340 m
B) 680 m
C) 170 m
D) 85 m

The angle of incidence in the denser medium for which the angle of refraction is 90° is the:

A) Glancing angle
B) Angle of deviation
C) Critical angle
D) Brewster angle

An object 30 cm from a converging lens forms an image 60 cm away (1/f = 1/u + 1/v). The focal length is:

A) 90 cm
B) 45 cm
C) 20 cm
D) 10 cm

A lens of focal length 0.5 m has a power of:

A) 0.5 dioptres
B) 5 dioptres
C) 50 dioptres
D) 2 dioptres

A 10 V supply drives a current of 0.5 A through a resistor. Its resistance is:

A) 5 Ω
B) 10.5 Ω
C) 20 Ω
D) 0.05 Ω

The induced e.m.f. in a coil can be increased by:

A) Using a weaker magnet
B) Reducing the number of turns
C) Moving the magnet faster
D) Holding the magnet still

mcq_options.text: Reverses its connection to the circuit every half turn through slip rings

items.prompt:
An a.c. generator produces an alternating current because the coil:

A) Reverses its connection to the circuit every half turn through slip rings
B) Stays still
C) Carries direct current
D) Has no magnetic field
items.correct_answer: A) Reverses its connection to the circuit every half turn through slip rings

items.prompt:
An ideal transformer with 800 primary and 200 secondary turns fed with 240 V gives an output of:

A) 960 V
B) 60 V
C) 240 V
D) 120 V
